# windows_file_acl (Data Source)

Reads the observed NTFS security descriptor of an existing file or directory without managing it.

Declarative attributes of the sibling resource (`mode`, `access_rule`, `preserve_inherited_on_protect`) are intentionally absent: the observed DACL is exposed read-only through `effective_access_rules` instead.

Returns an error when the target does not exist on the target host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Look up the observed security descriptor of an existing file.
data "windows_file_acl" "app_conf" {
  path = "C:\\data\\app.conf"
}

output "app_conf_owner_sid" {
  value = data.windows_file_acl.app_conf.owner_sid
}

output "app_conf_sddl" {
  value = data.windows_file_acl.app_conf.sddl
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file or directory whose security descriptor is read. The target must already exist.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `effective_access_rules` (List of Object) Every entry of the observed DACL, inherited ones included, in the order Windows returns them. Each element carries `identity`, `identity_sid`, `rights`, `access_mask`, `type`, `inheritance`, `propagation` and `inherited`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_access_rules))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: the normalised absolute path of the secured target.
- `inheritance_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the target inherits permissions from its parent, as observed on the host.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the target as reported by the host (display name form).
- `owner_sid` (String) Canonical SID of the observed owner.
- `sddl` (String) Security descriptor of the target in SDDL form, as observed on the host.
- `target_type` (String) Whether the target is a file or a directory, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--effective_access_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_access_rules`

Read-Only:

- `access_mask` (Number)
- `identity` (String)
- `identity_sid` (String)
- `inheritance` (String)
- `inherited` (Boolean)
- `propagation` (String)
- `rights` (List of String)
- `type` (String)
